name: Field Journal
subtitle: A demo of the handheld style
summary: Notes on the land, gathered on the road.
landing:
Welcome to the **Folios** demo. This book shows every kind of page a guide can have.

Pick a category to begin, or [jump straight to the basics](entry:basics/first_steps).

> Books are plain JSON in a resource pack: press **F3 + T** to reload them while you write.
